status_note: Planning record for the next application release. It is not a release, not a qualification result and not a version bump: the installed package still reports 5.0.0 until the separately authorized release-candidate milestone changes it.

offered.selection: default when no Ruleset is chosen

research_only.selection: `bytefray agents evaluate --ruleset <exact id>` or the Python API
research_only.promise: Research reproduction only. Not a product feature; no stability or compatibility promise.

application.name: Bytefray Spectator
application.release_status: unreleased and unversioned; no published build
application.distribution: separate application, not bundled; Designer finds it through `BYTEFRAY_SPECTATOR`, `<data root>/spectator/` or `bytefray-spectator` on `PATH`

platforms.bytefray: Primary target. M1 qualified (M1-6A). M2-5 technical/platform qualification reported PASS WITH CONDITIONS on a separate, unmerged lineage and awaits lead acceptance.
platforms.spectator: Executable built from tracked presets; automated self-checks and a real Designer end-to-end launch pass. No human GUI qualification.

platforms.bytefray: Headless-first wheel. Designer qualified on X11/Xvfb for M1 (M1-6B).
platforms.spectator: Executable built; headless checks only (WSL Ubuntu 24.04). No native desktop run.

limitations: Bytefray Spectator presents only completed two-entrant (A, B) Active Sensing (Alpha) matches; every other match opens in the Pygame viewer.
Spectator offers two perspectives: Broadcast and Agent A delivered information.

The Pygame viewer remains available for every supported workflow. Designer opens it instead of Spectator when Spectator is absent or turned off, does not support the match, or fails to export or launch. Once Spectator has started, Designer never reopens the match in Pygame; an immediate nonzero Spectator exit shows a warning.
The Pygame Active Sensing views (Agent A, Agent B, Omniscient) are a separate capability from Spectator's perspectives; entrant C has no delivered-information view.
Three-entrant or larger Spectator presentation is deferred.
Human comprehension evaluation of Active Sensing is deferred to 5.2.
Classic (`bytefray-rules-4`) stays the default on every surface; Active Sensing (Alpha) is never chosen automatically, including when a sensing starter is selected.
Spectator export time grows with the square of match length (about 40 s for 477 ticks); Designer prepares exports in the background.
The frozen (PyInstaller) Bytefray build has not yet been verified with `bytefray spectator`.
unsupported: Active Sensing (Alpha) in Designer Simple, in evaluation (CLI and Designer) or in tournaments.
Executing Agent API v1 agents, VM/blob agents or Redcode/pMARS warriors; their recorded artifacts stay readable, and Bytefray 5.0.0 still runs them.
New matches under the historical Rulesets listed as readable but not executable. The two retired research Rulesets remain executable for research reproduction only.
Spectator for Classic matches, three-entrant matches, tournaments or Replay History launches.
